title: PublishReadiness
description: The 'Build Gate ≠ Publish Readiness' layer (Phase 4.1). This is a PRODUCTION DECISION artifact that sits BESIDE the deterministic build gate — it does NOT violate ADR-003. A build is never blocked by an evaluative judgment (quality-report gating stays false). Separately, this artifact advises whether a chapter should be PUBLISHED. It is ADVISORY toward a human: `authority` is const 'human' (ADR-009) — the system may recommend 'block'/'hold', but only a human executes the irreversible publish transition. Two inputs feed the recommendation: the DETERMINISTIC safety red-line gate (which CAN hard-block, unlike the evaluative safety_risk score) and the evaluative quality-report v2 signals (retention/subscription/payoff/reader_drop_risk). Rides the Runtime envelope beside the draft.

subject.description: What this readiness verdict is about.

quality_report_ref.description: Pointer to the quality-report v2 this decision consumed.

authority.description: Structural invariant (ADR-009): the publish transition is irreversible/outward, so only a human executes it. This artifact stages a recommendation, never auto-publishes.

gates_build.description: Structural invariant: this artifact NEVER blocks a build. Build-blocking is only ever done by the deterministic red-line gate, reported under `basis.redline`, which is a separate concern from publish readiness.

recommendation.description: recommend = publish-ready; hold = fix advised before publish (soft); block = must not publish (a red-line hit forces this).

redline.description: The DETERMINISTIC safety check result. Unlike the evaluative safety_risk score, a red-line hit is objective and forces recommendation=block. This is the axis of safety that legitimately gates (ADR-003).

quality.description: Evaluative signals lifted from quality-report v2. Advisory only; can lower a recommendation to 'hold' but never to 'block' on its own (only a hard red-line blocks).

below_threshold.description: Dimensions under the hold threshold, driving a 'hold' recommendation.

policy.description: The thresholds that produced this recommendation, recorded for auditability/reproducibility.

rationale.description: Human-readable summary of why this recommendation was made.
